apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.1  (November 2026)  LESS UNUSED CODE
  - Parts of the program that nothing used any more were removed (old book functions, unused portal and QR helpers, unused
    imports). Nothing you see or do changes.
  - A correction to the 48.21.0 note: the Copy Security Rules and Make Giving Page Files buttons are no longer in Online
    Giving (Beacon Pastor → Publish Everything publishes the rules and the giving page); their code is kept for the Church
    Edition (see CHURCH_EDITION_GUIDE.txt, part 7).

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.43.2 - CERTIFICATES ON A4; THE BAPTISM CERTIFICATE WITH ITS BORDER; DOCUMENTS IN THE NEW LOOK
  - Both certificates are A4 (landscape), as PDF and as Word. The Certificate of Baptism has the church's blue Celtic border,
    24 pt from the paper's edge as in the Word certificate, made for A4; the design inside it is not stretched. Its words are
    where the church's Word certificate has them, in its fonts (Perpetua, Old English Text MT, Gill Sans MT, Vivaldi).
  - Documents: modern flat buttons and tabs (pills), in the colours of the theme; tabs that do not fit go to a second line.
    The buttons of a document (Save, Save & make PDF …) now stay in sight on a small screen. Baptism & Dedication: the same look.
  - Windows setup: the libraries are downloaded again whenever their list changes (a kept download could leave out
    reportlab and pypdf, added in 4.43.1), and the build stops if a listed library is not in the setup.
